# ADR 1: Built-in node:sqlite instead of a native database driver

Status: accepted (baseline template decision)

## Context

The app needs a local database with zero native compilation, so that `npm install --ignore-scripts` is always safe.

## Decision

Use Node.js’s built-in `node:sqlite` module through a single parameterised-query wrapper (`src/db/index.ts`).

## Consequences

No native modules to compile or audit; one file owns every SQL query, which is what makes the SAST rule against raw SQL concatenation possible.
